title: Account recovery
idea: Account recovery: The current recovery step and safe next action lead, with identity-sensitive information intentionally limited.
audience: People who need to recover account within a product-web surface.
worksWellWhen: People may be locked out and unfamiliar with security requirements.
avoidWhen: The screen would reveal whether another person's account exists.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its recover account priority and explicit commitment contract: Use verified backend recovery state and avoid account enumeration.
navigation: Account recovery keeps the current recover account context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: The current recovery step and safe next action lead, with identity-sensitive information intentionally limited.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to recover account; people may be locked out and unfamiliar with security requirements.
composition.priority: Use verified backend recovery state and avoid account enumeration.

imagery.role: Support the actual recover account context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep a single focused recovery action and visible alternate path under the keyboard.
Preserve entered data and focus when responsive panels become routes.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the account recovery structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no recover account content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Use verified backend recovery state and avoid account enumeration.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized recover account content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Use verified backend recovery state and avoid account enumeration.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active recover account context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure task interaction latency with representative data and slow network states.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
